name: OS Supply Chain Security
description: Assessment of operating system supply chain integrity and trust mechanisms. Covers driver signing infrastructure evaluation, kernel module signing and verification, OS update channel security (Windows Update, apt/yum repositories, macOS Software Update), boot chain code signing, package repository integrity, and OS-level software provenance verification.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to OS supply chain security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands OS supply chain trust mechanisms and common attack vectors
evidence: Can explain driver signing, code signing, and package signing across major OSes
Understands OS update mechanisms and their trust models
Familiar with historical software supply chain attacks bearing on OS trust (XZ Utils, and the SolarWinds and CCleaner application update-channel compromises)
Completed introductory training on software supply chain security

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Evaluates OS signing configurations and update mechanisms under supervision
evidence: Verified driver signing enforcement and certificate chain validation
Assessed apt/yum repository configuration and GPG key management
Reviewed Windows Update and WSUS configuration for integrity controls
Work reviewed by authorized assessor

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses OS supply chain integrity across platforms
evidence: Independently assessed OS update infrastructure for 3+ organizations
Evaluates driver and kernel module signing policy enforcement
Identifies weaknesses in package repository trust chains and mirroring
Passed proficiency assessment on OS supply chain security

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Evaluates complex supply chain trust architectures; simulates supply chain attacks
evidence: Simulates OS supply chain attack scenarios in controlled environments
Assesses third-party driver certificate trust chains and attestation signing, treating legacy cross-signed certificates as historical
Evaluates reproducible build systems and binary transparency for OS components
Mentors team on OS supply chain assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Authority on OS supply chain integrity; published supply chain research
evidence: Published research on OS supply chain vulnerabilities or defense mechanisms
Developed lab methodology for OS supply chain security assessment
Contributes to industry supply chain security standards and guidance
Trains teams and presents at conferences on OS supply chain threats

assessment_methods.description: Assess the OS update and driver signing infrastructure of a prepared environment, identifying supply chain integrity weaknesses
Review of OS supply chain assessment findings from recent engagements
